title: God's Righteous Judgment, The Jews and the Law

questions.question: Paul says that the person who judges others is inexcusable. Why?
options: Because the judge practices the very same things
Because judgment belongs only to God
Because judging is a violation of the law of love
Because no one is righteous, not even one
questions.correctAnswer: Because the judge practices the very same things
questions.explanation: Romans 2:1 (ESV): "Therefore you have no excuse, O man, every one of you who judges. For in passing judgment on another you condemn yourself, because you, the judge, practice the very same things."

questions.question: What is the purpose of God's kindness, forbearance, and patience which people often presume upon?
options: God's kindness is meant to lead you to repentance
God's patience allows time for the full number of Gentiles to come in
God's forbearance allows sinners to experience his love
God's kindness demonstrates his true nature before judgment falls
questions.correctAnswer: God's kindness is meant to lead you to repentance
questions.explanation: Romans 2:4 (ESV): "Or do you presume on the riches of his kindness and forbearance and patience, not knowing that God's kindness is meant to lead you to repentance?"

questions.question: By their hard and impenitent hearts, what are those who refuse to repent storing up for themselves?
options: Wrath for themselves on the day of wrath when God's righteous judgment will be revealed
Punishment multiplied for every day they delayed
A heavier burden of guilt under the law
Eternal separation from the presence of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Wrath for themselves on the day of wrath when God's righteous judgment will be revealed
questions.explanation: Romans 2:5 (ESV): "But because of your hard and impenitent heart you are storing up wrath for yourself on the day of wrath when God's righteous judgment will be revealed."

questions.question: God will render to each one according to his works. What will he give to those who by patience in well-doing seek for glory and honor and immortality?
questions.explanation: Romans 2:6-7 (ESV): "He will render to each one according to his works: to those who by patience in well-doing seek for glory and honor and immortality, he will give eternal life;"

questions.question: For those who are self-seeking and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, what will there be?
options: Eternal destruction from the Lord's presence
questions.explanation: Romans 2:8 (ESV): "but for those who are self-seeking and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, there will be wrath and fury."

questions.question: There will be tribulation and distress for every human being who does evil, the Jew first and also the Greek. What will there be for everyone who does good?
options: Joy and righteousness in the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Romans 2:9-10 (ESV): "There will be tribulation and distress for every human being who does evil, the Jew first and also the Greek, but glory and honor and peace for everyone who does good, the Jew first and also the Greek."

questions.question: Paul states a foundational principle regarding God's judgment of individuals from different backgrounds: "For God shows no ____."
According to Paul, who are the ones justified before God?
options: The doers of the law, not just the hearers of the law
Those who have faith, apart from works of the law
The children of Abraham by physical descent
Those who seek God with a sincere heart
questions.correctAnswer: The doers of the law, not just the hearers of the law
questions.explanation: Romans 2:13 (ESV): "For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law who will be justified."

questions.question: When Gentiles, who do not have the law, by nature do what the law requires, what do they show is written on their hearts?
questions.explanation: Romans 2:14-15 (ESV): "For when Gentiles, who do not have the law, by nature do what the law requires... They show that the work of the law is written on their hearts,"

questions.question: What bears witness along with the work of the law written on the hearts of Gentiles?
questions.explanation: Romans 2:15 (ESV): "while their conscience also bears witness, and their conflicting thoughts accuse or even excuse them"

questions.question: Paul says God judges the secrets of men by Christ Jesus on that day, according to what?
questions.explanation: Romans 2:16 (ESV): "on that day when, according to my gospel, God judges the secrets of men by Christ Jesus."

questions.question: Paul addresses the Jew who relies on the law and boasts in God. If he preaches against stealing but steals, or abhors idols but robs temples, what does he do to God through breaking the law?
questions.explanation: Romans 2:23 (ESV): "You who boast in the law dishonor God by breaking the law."

questions.question: Because of the hypocrisy of those who boast in the law but break it, what is blasphemed among the Gentiles?
questions.explanation: Romans 2:24 (ESV): "For, as it is written, 'The name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you.'"

questions.question: According to Paul, circumcision is indeed of value if you obey the law. What happens to your circumcision if you break the law?
options: It becomes a mark of judgment
questions.explanation: Romans 2:25 (ESV): "For circumcision indeed is of value if you obey the law, but if you break the law, your circumcision becomes uncircumcision."

questions.question: Paul redefines who is a true Jew. A Jew is one inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by what?
options: By the Spirit, not by the letter
questions.correctAnswer: By the Spirit, not by the letter
questions.explanation: Romans 2:29 (ESV): "But a Jew is one inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the letter. His praise is not from man but from God."

key_verse_text: Or do you presume on the riches of his kindness and forbearance and patience, not knowing that God's kindness is meant to lead you to repentance?
